title: Two reasoning models join the lineup
summary:
Two reasoning models joined the lineup, video got a proper player, and several generation edge cases got less weird.

Added Fireworks AI’s GLM-4.7 as `glm` and MiniMax-M2.1 as `minimax`, both with reasoning and tool support and roughly 200,000-token context windows. Enter’s model list also gained a recent-model indicator and clearer icons for audio input and output.

The Play page now renders output from video-capable models such as Veo 3.1 in a video player rather than an image element. Model choices gained description tooltips, while Enter’s pricing table now labels its videos-per-Pollen column “videos” instead of “seconds”; Veo’s figures remain seconds per Pollen.

Random seeds for text and image requests are now capped at Vertex AI’s supported signed 32-bit maximum. `gptimage` requests with different seeds also get separate cache entries instead of sharing one cached image. That fixes cache behavior, not deterministic generation: Azure GPT Image does not support reproducible output by seed.

highlights.title: GLM-4.7 joins the lineup
highlights.text: Try `glm` for reasoning and tool use, with a 198,000-token context window. [Browse GLM-4.7](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=glm).

highlights.title: MiniMax-M2.1 joins the lineup
highlights.text: Try `minimax` for reasoning and tool use, with a 200,000-token context window. [Browse MiniMax-M2.1](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=minimax).
